label: Distinct esse CAUSE_2 is SIMPLY_PRIOR_1, from actual esse-cause priority (inference)
rule: Discharge of the actuality antecedent: the effect has esse, hence exists at w and is concrete in the profile
meaning: Whatever has its esse caused is in act as to being (OPEN, CausedEsseIsHad); what is in act of esse exists at the selected world (OPEN); what has esse in re is concrete in the profile (OPEN, the CONCRETE_6 calibration). So the effect of a distinct cause of esse is an actual concretum at w, and the scoped esse-cause priority applies to it. The theorem imports actualEsseCausePriority's conclusion as its premise. Omitting the caused-esse premise leaves the other inputs while the conclusion fails (Control.OmitCausedEsseIsHad); all inputs hold jointly with a nonvacuous esse cause (Control.ScopeWitness). Conditional consequence only; no premise is established.
